about_the_game:
This DLC contains the Dimension "Cyberpunk 20XX". In it, you will have 5 musical themes, 5 ambient sounds and 10 stingers, all in the aesthetic of the Cyberpunk genre. All that in the palm of your hand. The Dimension details are as follows: 

D0001: Cyberpunk 20XX

Explore a chaotic future with grand settings and challenging battles.
Free Dimension (DLC)

- Genre: Cyberpunk

- Tracks:

  • City (theme for city scenery)

  • Battle (theme for combats)

  • Boss (theme  for boss battles)

  • Desert (theme for desert scenery)

  • Exploration (theme for area explorations)

- Composer: Arlam Jr.
